title: Linda’s Napa Cabbage Salad
source: From Linda  ·  Spring and summer lunches, holiday brunches
occasionText: Spring and summer lunches, holiday brunches
headnote: “Great recipe. I do not add the fruit or wonton. I might add chicken. No need to change.” — Linda, on her copy of the first draft

items.raw: 1 medium head Napa cabbage, thinly sliced
¼ cup chopped cilantro or mint (optional)

steps.text: Halve the cabbage lengthwise, cut out the core, and slice crosswise into thin ribbons. Julienne the carrot and slice the pepper and scallions.
Whisk the rice vinegar, orange juice, lime juice, soy sauce, honey, and ginger together, then whisk in both oils until emulsified. Season with salt and pepper.
Combine the cabbage, carrot, pepper, scallions, and herbs in a large bowl.
Drizzle with the dressing and toss gently.
Scatter the toasted almonds over the top just before serving so they stay crisp.

notes.label: Make it a meal
notes.text: Linda sometimes adds chicken. Sliced grilled chicken or shredded rotisserie chicken both work.

notes.label: Ahead of time
notes.text: slice the vegetables and make the dressing up to a day ahead. Dress the salad just before serving.

notes.label: Toasting almonds
notes.text: toast them in a dry skillet over medium heat, stirring, 3 to 4 minutes, until golden and fragrant.
